visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static shot of a blurred outdoor field featuring tall grass swaying slightly under the warm, golden light of a setting sun. A centered, square white card acts as the primary visual focus, decorated with a painting of several red roses on its right side. Above the card, a line of white text asks a question in Traditional Chinese, while a persistent instruction line appears at the very bottom of the frame. (2) The Traditional Chinese text inside the square card changes to a different set of sentences, though the rose graphic and the background scenery remain identical. The lighting is soft and consistent, highlighting the texture of the white card against the out-of-focus natural background. A stylized red signature is visible at the bottom of the card's text area. (3) The text on the central card cycles to a third quote, maintaining the same font and layout. The camera does not move, keeping the viewer's attention on the changing text. The overall visual style is reminiscent of a digital quote card or a social media fortune-telling loop, characterized by high saturation and warm color tones.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 宇宙要給你什麼啟示?. [Slogan]: 長按暫停螢幕接受訊息. [Logo]: 雨揚老師心靈語錄. [Subtitle]: 偶然無法期待; 必然無法安排; 「擁有」是一種獲得; 「沒有」也是一種收穫! 隨緣自然，一切自在!. (2) [Subtitle]: 善待自己，是修行的第一步。當你懂得溫柔地擁抱自己，護好自己的心，慢慢地，你的人生也因此豐盈。. (3) [Subtitle]: 荊棘塵埃也好，沒有人理解也罷，都要保持平靜、臨危不亂。如果你的生活已處於低谷，那更要大幅前進，因為無論你怎樣走，都是進步的。

The background is completely silent, free of any environmental noise or digital sound effects.
